Email Support
01

Try these steps first

  • Update IDVault and your device to the latest available version.
  • Close and reopen IDVault, then try the action again.
  • Review camera, NFC, notification, Photos, and iCloud access in System Settings.
02

Protect your documents

Never email scans, document photos, MRZ data, document numbers, or other identity details. We will not ask for your device passcode, Apple Account password, or encryption keys.
